title: Browse decoded background tile sheets
changes: Render decoded background graphic words as paginated 4-bit tile sheets, linked by descriptor and displayed with an extracted base palette bank or grayscale indices.
Label relative source and destination tile offsets without inventing omitted destination prefixes or assembling a scene.
validation: Synthetic Linux Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-bgtiles-r4lnzrf7 checked nibble order, RGB palette conversion, descriptor aliases, pagination, destination offsets and invalid data.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-bgtiles-eur-7pw4d56v compared all 162 descriptor links and 50 decoded word arrays, then checked an independently calculated palette pixel and final descriptor/page selection in Chrome.
limitations: This is a 4-bit tile interpretation, not a complete background scene; missing prefixes, dynamic palettes and animation are not reconstructed.
